input: My flight SK214 tomorrow got cancelled. I have a wedding to go to!! What are my options
expected:
I'm so sorry, especially with a wedding to get to. Because Skylark cancelled the flight, you can choose either:
1. A free rebooking onto another flight. In the app or on skylark.example, go to Manage booking and the available alternatives will be shown.
2. A full refund to your original payment method.
If none of the alternatives get you there in time, reply with your booking reference and last name, and I'll pass it to our customer team to look at other options with you.

input: how big can my cabin bag be on a basic fare
expected: On a Basic fare you can bring one under-seat bag up to 40 x 30 x 20 cm, such as a small backpack or handbag. A 10 kg cabin bag isn't included, but you can add a checked bag in Manage booking for $35 online, which is cheaper than the $60 at the airport.

input: I'm at the airport, flight delayed 4 hours, nobody's telling us anything. Do I get anything??
expected: Sorry, waiting without information is exhausting. With a delay over 3 hours, you're entitled to a meal voucher. Collect it at the Skylark desk or in the app under My trip > Vouchers. If the delay goes past 5 hours, you can choose a full refund or a free rebooking instead of flying. For live updates, keep an eye on the app and the departure boards. You can also call the 24/7 line in the app under Help.

input: Can I change my flight date? Standard fare.
expected:
Yes. On a Standard fare, you can change the date for $45 plus any difference in fare.
1. Go to Manage booking on skylark.example or in the app.
2. Choose Change flight and pick the new date.
3. The total cost shows before you confirm.
Changes can be made up to 2 hours before the original departure.

input: they lost my suitcase, landed 2 hours ago in Porto. what now
expected: I'm sorry, that's a horrible way to arrive. If you haven't yet, please report it at the baggage services desk in the arrivals hall before you leave the airport, and get the report reference. Most delayed bags turn up within a couple of days. Keep receipts for essentials like toiletries and a change of clothes. Once you have the reference, reply with it and your booking reference, and I'll pass it to our customer team to follow up.

input: Can my 12 year old fly alone to her grandparents?
expected: Children aged 12 and over can travel alone on Skylark, and we offer an optional escort service for ages 12–15. For children under 12, the unaccompanied minor service is required. As arrangements involve paperwork and confirmed handovers, I've passed your question to our customer team, and they'll reply within 24 hours with the forms and next steps.

input: Do I need a visa to go to Morocco?
expected: Visa requirements depend on your nationality and passport, so I can't give you a definite answer. Please check the official government website of Morocco or your own country's foreign travel advice for the latest rules. Also make sure your passport is valid for your whole stay, as many countries need at least 6 months' validity.

input: i want a refund. flex fare, flight is next week
expected:
On a Flex fare, you can cancel for a full refund up to 2 hours before departure.
1. Go to Manage booking on skylark.example or in the app.
2. Choose Cancel flight > Refund.
The refund goes back to your original payment method, usually within 7–10 business days.

input: Can I bring my cat on board? She's about 5kg
expected: Yes, small pets can travel in the cabin on most routes, as long as the cat and carrier together weigh no more than 8 kg. Your cat should be fine. It costs $50, and you need to request it at least 48 hours before departure in Manage booking > Extras > Pet in cabin. The carrier must fit under the seat in front of you.

input: My mum uses a wheelchair, how do I arrange help at the airport?
expected:
We'd be glad to help. Assistance is free. Please request it at least 48 hours before departure:
1. Go to Manage booking > Special assistance.
2. Choose the type of help she needs, for example getting to the gate, or help up the aircraft steps.
3. If she's bringing her own wheelchair, add its type and size.
If she has a medical condition we should know about, reply and I'll pass it to our team to confirm the details with you.

input: missed my connection in Lisbon because the first flight was late. both skylark. stuck here
expected: I'm sorry you're stuck. Because both flights are on one Skylark booking, we'll get you to your destination. Please go to the Skylark transfer desk in the terminal, or call the 24/7 line in the app under Help, as they can rebook you right now. I've also passed this to our customer team. If you have to stay overnight, keep all your receipts.

input: check-in won't let me, says 'not available'
expected: Online check-in opens 30 hours and closes 2 hours before departure, so that message often means you're outside that window. It can also show if a passenger's details, such as a passport, need adding first in Manage booking. If you're inside the window and your details are complete, reply with your booking reference and last name, and I'll pass it to our team.

input: How much to add a checked bag?
expected: A 23 kg checked bag costs $35 when you add it online in Manage booking, or $60 at the airport. It's already included in Flex fares.

input: This is the worst airline. Rude staff at the gate in Madrid, flight delayed 6 hours, and I want compensation.
expected: I'm sorry. A 6-hour delay and a bad experience with our staff aren't acceptable. Because the delay was over 5 hours, you can choose a full refund for the unused flight if you didn't travel. I've passed your complaint about the staff and your compensation request to our customer team. They'll reply within 24 hours. If you can, add your booking reference and the date and time of what happened at the gate.

input: can I take a baby on my lap? she's 9 months
expected: Yes. Infants under 2 can travel on a parent's lap for $25 per flight, with one infant per adult. Add her in Manage booking > Passengers > Add infant. You can also bring a pushchair and a car seat for free, and drop the pushchair at the aircraft door.

input: I booked the wrong name on the ticket, it's spelled Jhon instead of John
expected: That's easy to fix. Small spelling corrections of up to 3 letters are free. Go to Manage booking > Passengers > Correct name. If that option doesn't appear, reply with your booking reference and I'll pass it to our team to correct it before you fly, because the name must match your ID.

input: my guitar, can I bring it on board
expected: Yes. A guitar can come in the cabin if it fits in the overhead bin, though space is first come, first served. To guarantee a spot, you can buy an extra seat for it. You can also check it in as a musical instrument in a hard case for $50 in Manage booking > Extras.

input: can I cancel my basic fare? I'm sick and can't travel
expected: I'm sorry you're unwell. Basic fares can't be changed or refunded unless Skylark cancels the flight. If you have travel insurance, it may cover cancellation due to illness, so contact your insurer with a doctor's note. You can also cancel in Manage booking to release the seat, and any airport taxes will be refunded on request.

input: hi, group of 14 for a work trip in March, can you hold seats?
expected: Lovely, thanks for thinking of us. Groups of 10 or more are handled by our groups team, who can hold seats and offer flexible name changes. I've passed your request to them, and they'll reply within 24 hours. To speed things up, reply with the route, the dates and roughly how many people need checked bags.

input: I got charged twice for my booking SKX9PL
expected: Sorry for the worry. Sometimes the second charge is a temporary hold from your bank that drops off within a few days. In case it's a real double charge, I've passed booking SKX9PL to our customer team to check, and they'll reply within 24 hours. Please don't post card details here. The booking reference is enough.

input: What time does bag drop close?
expected: Bag drop closes 45 minutes before departure. Arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before your flight, so you have time for bag drop and security.

input: My bag came out of the carousel with a broken wheel and a big crack
expected: Sorry your bag was damaged. If you're still at the airport, please report it at the baggage services desk and get a damage report reference. If you've already left, report it within 7 days. Take photos of the damage. Then reply with your booking reference and the report reference, and I'll pass it to our customer team to handle the claim.

input: can i choose my seat for free?
expected: On Basic and Standard fares, we assign a seat for free at check-in, or you can choose one in advance for a small fee in Manage booking > Seats. Flex fares include free seat selection. If you're travelling with children under 12, we'll seat at least one adult with them for free.

input: I need oxygen during the flight for my COPD
expected: Thank you for letting us know ahead of time. Medical oxygen has to be arranged and approved in advance, and you'll usually need a form from your doctor. I've passed your request to our special assistance team, and they'll reply within 24 hours with the forms and options. Please let them know your flight date and route.

input: weather delayed my flight 6h and i just want my money back, didn't fly
expected: I'm sorry about the long delay. Because it was over 5 hours, you can choose a full refund for the flight you didn't take, whatever caused the delay. Go to Manage booking > Cancel flight > Refund (delay). If that option doesn't show, reply with your booking reference and I'll pass it to our team.

input: is there wifi on board
expected: Wi-Fi is available on most of our aircraft. You'll see a Skylark Wi-Fi network once the plane is in the air. Messaging is free, and browsing passes can be bought on board. On some older aircraft there's no Wi-Fi, and the app's My trip screen shows whether your flight has it.
